JOHNSON COUNTY OFFICES​
​ ASSESSOR - values all property in Johnson County​
​ ​COUNTY ATTORNEY - prosecutes or defends all criminal suits in which the State or County has an interest
​COUNTY CLERK - record keeper for the County
COUNTY SHERIFF - lawful authority for Johnson County
​COUNTY TREASURER - bills and collects revenue for Johnson County
​ DISTRICT COURT CLERK - keeps the records, books, and papers pertaining to the court, and record its proceedings
EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY - develops disaster prevention, preparedness, response and recovery system for Johnson County
​
|
HIGHWAY SUPERINTENDENT - serves as a steward of the County’s roads​
JOHNSON COUNTY EXTENSION OFFICE - offers research based information in agriculture and natural resources, consumer and family economics, community and economic development, and 4-H / youth development ​
REGISTER OF DEEDS - keeps a record of all instruments filed for record at her office
SURVEYOR - makes or causes to be made all surveys within his or her county that the county surveyor may be called upon to make and record the same​
VETERAN'S SERVICE OFFICE - assists Veterans with various claims, paperwork, and benefits
​ZONING ADMINISTRATOR - responsible for zoning and building requests for the County
